personal_relationships_community_childre.text: Are there any children in %1 life?
personal_relationships_community_childre.hint:
This refers to any children (under 18 years) %1 has regular contact with, even if they do not have parental responsibility.

Select all that apply.

YES_CHILDREN_LIVING_WITH_POP.text: Yes, children that live with them
YES_CHILDREN_LIVING_WITH_POP.label: Include the name, age and sex of any children, and their relationship to %1.
YES_CHILDREN_LIVING_WITH_POP.validation: Enter details of any children that live with them

YES_CHILDREN_NOT_LIVING_WITH_POP.text: Yes, children that do not live with them
YES_CHILDREN_NOT_LIVING_WITH_POP.label: Include the name, age and sex of any children, and their relationship to %1.
YES_CHILDREN_NOT_LIVING_WITH_POP.validation: Enter details of any children that do not live with them

YES_CHILDREN_VISITING.text: Yes, children that visit them regularly
YES_CHILDREN_VISITING.label: Include the name, age and sex of any children, and their relationship to %1.
YES_CHILDREN_VISITING.validation: Enter details of any children that visit them regularly

NO_CHILDREN.text: No, there are no children in %1 life

personal_relationships_community_importa.text: Who are the important people in %1 life?

PARTNER_INTIMATE_RELATIONSHIP.text: Partner or someone they’re in an intimate relationship with
PARTNER_INTIMATE_RELATIONSHIP.hint: Include their name, age, gender and the nature of their relationship. For example, if they’re in a casual or committed relationship.

CHILD_PARENTAL_RESPONSIBILITIES.text: Their children or anyone they have parenting responsibilities for
CHILD_PARENTAL_RESPONSIBILITIES.label: Give details of any children not captured by the previous question (optional)

personal_relationships_community_current.text: Is %1 happy with their current relationship status?
personal_relationships_community_current.validation: Select if they are happy with their current relationship status

HAPPY_RELATIONSHIP.text: Happy and positive about their relationship status or their relationship is likely to act as a protective factor

CONCERNS_HAPPY_RELATIONSHIP.text: Has some concerns about their relationship status but is overall happy

UNHAPPY_RELATIONSHIP.text: Unhappy about their relationship status or their relationship is unhealthy and directly linked to offending

personal_relationships_community_intimat.text: What is %1 history of intimate relationships?
personal_relationships_community_intimat.hint: An intimate relationship is one that involves physical and/or emotional closeness.
personal_relationships_community_intimat.validation: Select their history of intimate relationships

STABLE_RELATIONSHIPS.text: History of stable, supportive, positive and rewarding relationships
STABLE_RELATIONSHIPS.hint: This includes if they do not have a history of relationships but appear capable of starting and maintaining one.
STABLE_RELATIONSHIPS.detailsHint: Consider patterns and quality of any significant relationships.

POSITIVE_AND_NEGATIVE_RELATIONSHIPS.text: History of both positive and negative relationships
POSITIVE_AND_NEGATIVE_RELATIONSHIPS.detailsHint: Consider patterns and quality of any significant relationships.

UNSTABLE_RELATIONSHIPS.text: History of unstable, unsupportive and destructive relationships
UNSTABLE_RELATIONSHIPS.hint: This includes if they are single and have never had a relationship but would like one.
UNSTABLE_RELATIONSHIPS.detailsHint: Consider patterns and quality of any significant relationships.

personal_relationships_community_challen.text: Is %1 able to resolve any challenges in their intimate relationships?
personal_relationships_community_challen.hint: Consider how resilient they are, and how they work with their partner to resolve issues when they arise. An intimate relationship is one that involves physical and/or emotional closeness.

personal_relationships_community_parenta.text: Is %1 able to manage their parenting responsibilities?
personal_relationships_community_parenta.hint: If there are parenting concerns, it does not always mean there are child wellbeing concerns. They may just require some help or support.
personal_relationships_community_parenta.validation: Select if they’re able to manage their parenting responsibilities

NO.text: No, is not able to manage parenting responsibilities

personal_relationships_community_family_.text: What is %1 current relationship like with their family?
personal_relationships_community_family_.hint: Consider any relationships that may act like family support.
personal_relationships_community_family_.validation: Select what their current relationship is like with their family

STABLE_RELATIONSHIP.text: Stable, supportive, positive and rewarding relationship

UNSTABLE_RELATIONSHIP.hint: This includes those who have little or no contact with their family.

personal_relationships_community_childho.text: What was %1 experience of their childhood?
personal_relationships_community_childho.hint: Childhood is the period up to and including 18 years old.

NEGATIVE_CHILDHOOD.hint: This includes things like permanent or long-term separation from their parents or guardians, inconsistent care, neglect or abuse.

personal_relationships_community_childho.text: Did %1 have any childhood behavioural problems?
personal_relationships_community_childho.hint: Consider any adverse experiences and trauma, as well as neurodiversity that could lead to behavioural problems.
personal_relationships_community_childho.validation: Select if they had childhood behavioural problems

personal_relationships_community_belongi.text: Is %1 part of any groups or communities that gives them a sense of belonging? (optional)
personal_relationships_community_belongi.hint: For example, online social media or community groups.

personal_relationships_community_changes.text: Does %1 want to make changes to their personal relationships and community?

personal_relationships_community_practit.text: Are there any strengths or protective factors related to %1 personal relationships and community?
personal_relationships_community_practit.hint: Include any strategies, people or support networks that helped.

Give details on strengths or protective factors related to their personal relationships and community

personal_relationships_community_practit.validation: Select if linked to risk of serious harm
Give details on the risk of serious harm
